# 台灣索尼 (Sony Taiwan)

> > Official Sony Taiwan website featuring BRAVIA XR televisions, α (Alpha) cameras, Xperia smartphones, audio equipment, and professional imaging solutions.

Sony Taiwan's comprehensive product catalog showcases advanced technologies including XR Processor cognitive intelligence for BRAVIA TVs, G Master lenses for α System cameras, OLED displays, and professional audio/video equipment. The site serves consumers and professionals with detailed product specifications, creative tools, and accessibility features.

## Key Topics

- BRAVIA XR televisions and XR Processor
- OLED display technology
- α (Alpha) camera system (α7 V, ILCE-7M5)
- G Master lenses and optics
- Creative Look photo presets and picture profiles
- Xperia smartphones and accessories
- Cinema Line professional cameras
- Google TV smart platform
- Cognitive intelligence TV features
- Ambient optimization technology
- Professional audio equipment
- Car audio systems
- Gaming gear and INZONE products
- Accessibility features (TalkBack, closed captions)
